title: Portfolio / Position -> Hierarchy Binding (OMNI-2)
description: A book of positions bound to instruments, issuer/counterparty entities, and the omnirisk allocation hierarchy the OMNI-1 walker aggregates. Supplies the data SOURCE the walker assumes. Read-only over the entity-resolution plane: the 'entities' roster is a by-contract snapshot of regis-entity-graph EntityNodes, never a live read.

entities.description: Issuer/counterparty roster. By-contract snapshot of regis-entity-graph EntityNode {node_id, kind}; NOT a live ER read. Keyed by node_id.

kind.description: regis-entity-graph EntityNode.kind. Only ORG/PERSON/ENTITY_CLUSTER may stand as an issuer/counterparty.

instruments.description: Instrument catalog keyed by instrument_ref. Each carries an asset_class on the ladder and an issuer_ref resolving into 'entities'.

asset_class.description: A rung on the asset-class ladder; each maps to an economic-prophet F builder.

issuer_ref.description: node_id of the issuer/counterparty EntityNode in 'entities'.

f_builder.description: Soft reference to the F builder that scores this asset class (informational).

positions.description: The book of holdings. Each position sources exposure onto exactly one hierarchy leaf.

exposure.description: The economic-capital contribution this holding sources onto its leaf; the conserved quantity.

leaf_ref.description: node_ref of the omnirisk hierarchy LEAF this position backs. The tree places that leaf under an org-cut node in every cut.

tree.description: The omnirisk RiskAllocationTree (cuts map) the book rolls into — the exact shape the OMNI-1 walker consumes. Validated by gbrg.governance.omnirisk_allocation.
